title: E v2: original pixel-letter companion and staged choreography
statement: Propose upgrading the optional A dope E Commons presentation mascot from an automatic speech widget into an original, expressive pixel-art E with a pure behaviour model and accessible controls. The initial draft slice provides poses and explicit side missions; safe-anchor movement and deterministic three-minute presentation choreography remain proposed future stages. This does not change the current Human Signal concept.
conditions: No human acceptance or production deployment is implied by this assistant proposal.
Original artwork only; no copying Mistral, Adobe, Clippy or other proprietary sprites.
Keep Commons fully usable without E or optional Adobe/PDF framing.
Run typecheck, tests, build and browser accessibility checks before merge; these have not been independently run.
PDF side missions currently open repository source directories, not verified runnable demos.
Stage B wandering and Stage C presentation are proposals, not implemented.
Public published knowledge and snapshot fetches failed; no claim of resolved/current publication is made.
